# Ajulo Web Solutions

> We build fast, mobile-first websites and automation for UK service businesses — trades and removals (our deepest specialism), plus salons, solicitors, accountants and interior designers. Specialists in GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) so customers find businesses on Google, Maps and AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity.
